meta.title: Hue Imperial City Tour – Inside Vietnam’s Forbidden City
meta.description:
Today I take a full walking tour of the famous Hue Imperial City, one of the most important historical sites in Huế.

Also known as Vietnam’s Forbidden City, this vast complex was once the seat of the Nguyen Dynasty and is now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

I explore the entire complex, walking through the ancient gates, courtyards, temples and palace buildings that make up this incredible historical location.

The Imperial City is one of the top attractions in Hue and gives a fascinating insight into Vietnam’s royal history and architecture.

This is a full, real-time walk through the site, showing exactly what visitors can expect when they visit Hue Imperial City today.

No script.
No edits.
Just real travel as it happens.
